ADVS.AVISIT.CR-10.reason: Define-XML ADVS.AVISIT covers observed-visit labels, while SAP page-10 (Week 24 or early termination) and pages 17/40-42 (last on-treatment visit on or before Week 24) give endpoint definitions without an operational candidate, on-treatment or tie rule. Pilot 6 advs.r L157-L168 picks the last record by ADT, AVISITN, ATPTN and AVAL among AVISITN > 2, a choice no retained document states.

ADVS.BASE.CR-10.reason: The retained original XML or governing SAP contains the rule, but the prior scalar adapter did not expose the complete value-level/source metadata. This is incomplete checker coverage, not an established documentation defect. Define-XML ADVS.BASE states the flagged VS.VSSTRESN lookup, the ADVS ItemGroupDef at define-adam.xml lines 3303-3304 fixes the subject/parameter/timepoint keys, native VS.VSBLFL at define-sdtm.xml lines 5035-5044 flags the BASELINE visit, and native lines 15387-15438 give the parameter-level types. Leaving that retained metadata out of the section adapter does not make the documented rule incomplete; Pilot 6 advs.r L176-L180 groups by the same keys.

ADVS.CHG.CR-10.reason: The original retained Define-XML value-level declarations contain the complete assignments; the old scalar reading adapter omitted them. Supported native parameter-specific assignments were independently checked.
